title: power down system
caption_en: To power down the system, touch the ONOFF-DIM key.
caption_tr: Sistemi kapatmak için ONOFF-DIM tuşuna dokunun.

title: dimming control window
caption_en: The dimming control window will be displayed. Touch the OFF
caption_tr: Karartma kontrol penceresi görüntülenecektir. KAPALI'ya dokunun

title: system will shut
caption_en: The system will now shut down when you touch the CONFIRM OFF
caption_tr: ONAYLA KAPAT tuşuna dokunduğunuzda sistem artık kapanacaktır.

title: system turned off
caption_en: The system is now turned off.
